description: This file defines classes and functions for VRB-to-PRB resource mapping in 5G NR resource allocation, including configurations for interleaved and non-interleaved mappings, with functions to create specific configurations based on 3GPP specifications.

classes.name: configuration
classes.description: Holds parameters for VRB-to-PRB mapping, including bundle counts and sizes, with methods to check interleaving and compare configurations.

classes.name: non_interleaved_mapping
classes.description: Handles VRB-to-PRB mapping for non-interleaved configurations, providing conversion functions.

classes.name: interleaved_mapping
classes.description: Handles VRB-to-PRB mapping for interleaved configurations, providing conversion functions.

methods.name: create_non_interleaved_common_ss
methods.description: Creates a non-interleaved VRB-to-PRB configuration for DCI Format 1_0 scheduled in common search space.

methods.name: create_non_interleaved_other
methods.description: Creates a non-interleaved VRB-to-PRB configuration for DCI other than Format 1_0.

methods.name: create_interleaved_coreset0
methods.description: Creates an interleaved VRB-to-PRB configuration for CORESET0 scheduled with DCI Format 1_0.

methods.name: create_interleaved_common_ss
methods.description: Creates an interleaved VRB-to-PRB configuration for common search space except Type0-PDCCH.

methods.name: create_interleaved_other
methods.description: Creates an interleaved VRB-to-PRB configuration for other PDSCH transmissions.
